title: Set Up: Fur, Feathers and Scales

scenes.tts: You need a tray, feathers from a craft store, a scrap of fake fur, two or three clean empty shells, and animal pictures. A small piece of raw fish is optional.
scenes.narration: You need a tray, feathers from a craft store, a scrap of fake fur, two or three clean empty shells, and animal pictures. A small piece of raw fish is optional.

scenes.tts: Lay a feather, the fur, and a shell on the tray, a hand's width apart. Keep the pictures face down. Your child touches each one and finds two words for it.
scenes.narration: Lay a feather, the fur, and a shell on the tray, a hand's width apart. Keep the pictures face down. Your child touches each one and finds two words for it.

scenes.tts: Put three drops of water on the feather and three on the fur. Water often beads up on a feather. Fur varies. Then turn the pictures over and match each covering to its animals.

items.text: 3 drops each on feather and fur
Water often beads up on feathers

scenes.narration: Put three drops of water on the feather and three on the fur. Water often beads up on a feather. Fur varies. Then turn the pictures over and match each covering to its animals.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time. An adult handles any raw fish, which can carry germs.
